zh.title: DHL貨運波音737機降落洛杉磯爆胎起火 FAA展開調查
zh.summary: DHL貨運波音737降落洛杉磯爆胎起火；機組員全數平安；FAA已展開調查
body: 2026年8月26日，一架由Kalitta Charters II執飛、代表DHL營運的波音737-800BDSF貨機（航班號K5-1814），自鳳凰城天港國際機場（PHX）飛往洛杉磯國際機場（LAX）。該機於當地時間深夜23時左右降落洛杉磯國際機場25L跑道時，疑似發生煞車系統故障，導致主起落架爆胎並冒出火花與火焰。
根據現場拍攝影片顯示，這架國籍標誌登記為N326FL的波音737貨機在跑道正常觸地後，主起落架隨即噴出大量白煙。數秒後現場傳出多聲巨響，機底起落架區域出現閃光與火苗。飛機在起落架夾帶火花與煙霧的情況下繼續滑行，最終在跑道上安全減速停止。
無線電通話紀錄顯示，機組人員在降落過程中向管制塔台回報疑似煞車問題，飛行員指出感覺煞車鎖死。洛杉磯國際機場消防隊隨即趕赴現場，對熱煞車與起落架區域進行噴水處置。受此事故影響，25L跑道暫時封閉以確保安全，其他航班均被指示避開該跑道，直到次日晨間該跑道仍維持封閉狀態。
美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）發布初步資訊指出，該架貨機在降落時煞車鎖死並造成四條輪胎爆裂，目前FAA已就本起事故展開詳細調查。DHL則在聲明中表示，事故起因為顯著煞車系統異常導致煞車過熱，並確認機上所有機組人員均安全無恙、未有人員受傷。
據FAA登記紀錄顯示，該架波音737-800貨機於2001年出廠製造，並於2022年12月完成從客機改裝為貨機（BDSF）的工程。目前營運方Kalitta Charters II正著手移動該架受損飛機，以便後續進行更詳細的技術檢查與評估。

en.title: DHL Boeing 737 Cargo Jet Suffers Tire Blowout and Gear Fire at LAX
en.summary: DHL Boeing 737 freighter suffers brake lockup and tire fire during landing at Los Angeles International Airport.
body: On August 26, 2026, a Kalitta Charters II Boeing 737-800BDSF freighter operating as DHL Flight K5-1814 from Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) to Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) suffered an apparent brake malfunction upon landing. The aircraft landed on Runway 25L at approximately 23:00 local time when four tires blew out and flames erupted from the main landing gear.

Video footage captured at the scene shows the Boeing 737 touching down normally before dense white smoke began billowing from the main gear. Seconds later, multiple loud pops were heard as flashes and flames burst beneath the fuselage. The aircraft continued its landing rollout with sparks and fire trailing behind before coming to a stop on the runway.

Air traffic control audio accompanying the flight captured the crew reporting potential mechanical trouble to the tower, with one pilot stating that the brakes felt as though they had locked up. Airport emergency fire crews arrived shortly after the aircraft stopped and sprayed down the overheated landing gear assembly. Runway 25L was kept closed into the following morning while crews remained on site.

Preliminary information released by the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) indicates that the aircraft’s brakes locked up during landing, resulting in four blown tires. The agency has launched a detailed investigation into the event. DHL confirmed in a statement that the incident was caused by an apparent brake system issue that led to severe overheating, adding that no injuries occurred and all crew members are safe.

According to FAA registry records, the Boeing 737-800 aircraft (registration N326FL) was originally manufactured in 2001 and converted from passenger to freighter configuration in December 2022. Operating carrier Kalitta Charters II is coordinating efforts to move the disabled aircraft from the runway to enable comprehensive inspections.

zh.title: 德國國防軍啟用雷達鳥擊預警軟體平台VoVisWxBw
zh.summary: 德國國防軍啟用新軟體平台；每小時分析80萬雷達資料預警鳥擊
body: 德國聯邦國防軍於2026年8月27日公布正式啟用名為VoVisWxBw的新型軟體平台。該平台每小時可處理超過80萬個雷達資料點，並將資料轉換為鳥類活動的即時顯示畫面，協助專家針對潛在的碰撞危害向軍用飛機機組人員發出警報。
VoVisWxBw由德國聯邦國防軍網路與資訊空間數位化暨能力發展中心，與德國聯邦地理資訊中心（ZGeoBw）合作開發。系統研發工作歷時數月並於2025年底完成，用以取代先前用於收集與評估軍用鳥類遷徙雷達資料的舊版應用程式。國防軍指出，舊有系統在技術上已屬過時，且日常維護工作變得日益困難。
在功能設計上，VoVisWxBw可呈現二維與三維的雷達資訊介面。操作人員能夠將最新的雷達回波與歷史紀錄進行比對，藉由動態循環畫面觀察鳥群的移動方向與發展趨勢，同時疊加保護區地圖進行綜合分析。該軟體透過敏捷開發模式打造，讓實務專家能在日常工作中提出需求並進行新功能測試。
在實際維運與防護機制方面，ZGeoBw的專業人員會解讀即時雷達圖樣，並據此繪製發布鳥類飛行通告（BIRDTAM）。這些警告資訊同時提供給軍方與民用航管使用者參考，協助飛行員在規劃與執行任務時納入安全考量。當地區鳥類活動達到第五級強度時，德國聯邦國防軍即會開始對相關飛行作業實施限制。
統計數據顯示，德國聯邦國防軍每年記錄超過130起鳥擊碰撞事故。在2024年的飛行作業中，廣義野生動物撞擊事件中有10%導致設備受損。軍用航空因訓練與任務需要而頻繁於低空進行飛行作業，該高度區間常有大量鳥類活動，使防範鳥擊成為保障軍事飛行安全的重要課題。

en.title: German Armed Forces deploy radar-based bird warning software
en.summary: German Armed Forces deployed radar software platform VoVisWxBw in August 2026 to warn aircrews of bird strike hazards.
body: The German Armed Forces (Bundeswehr) unveiled a new software platform named VoVisWxBw on August 27, 2026, designed to process more than 800,000 radar data points per hour. The platform translates incoming radar signals into visual displays of bird movements, allowing specialists to warn military aircrews about potential collision hazards during flight operations.

VoVisWxBw was developed by the Bundeswehr Center for Digitalization and Capability Development of the Cyber and Information Domain in cooperation with the Bundeswehr Geoinformation Center (ZGeoBw). System development was completed at the end of 2025 following several months of work. The platform replaces an older radar data collection application that the Bundeswehr described as technically obsolete and increasingly difficult to maintain.

The platform presents radar information in two- and three-dimensional views, allowing operators to compare live returns with historical radar data, review animated loops to identify flock trajectories, and overlay maps of protected bird areas. The software was built using an agile development process that permitted ZGeoBw specialists to submit operational requirements and test functions during their daily duties.

Specialists at ZGeoBw interpret real-time radar patterns on the platform to formulate Bird Notices to Airmen (BIRDTAMs). These hazard warnings contain specific validity areas, intensity levels, and warning zones, which are made available to both military and civilian airspace users for flight planning. The Bundeswehr initiates flight restrictions when bird activity reaches intensity level five.

According to Bundeswehr figures, the military records more than 130 bird collisions each year. In 2024, 10% of recorded wildlife-strike incidents during flight operations resulted in aircraft damage. Military aviation operations are particularly exposed to these risks because training and operational flights frequently take place at low altitudes where bird concentrations are highest.
